beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A useful AI product can succeed with customers and still lose its independence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Investing in an AI-Dominated Economy builds its thesis around that uncomfortable distinction.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book presents the strategic doctrine behind Outfinity Venture Studio.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It asks what a company retains when competitors can rent the same intelligence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers gain a framework for examining that wager, including reasons it could fail.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Imagine a review tool whose main attraction is generating a polished report.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: An enterprise suite could bundle that feature into a service customers already use.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book distinguishes demand for the feature from bargaining power for its supplier.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It asks what each deployment accumulates beyond another sale.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Reusable evaluations and lawful learning rights matter only when they actually strengthen the company.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A report can be fluent while leaving authority and responsibility unresolved.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The business chapters follow work through permissions, checks, decisions, and retained evidence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A model may change while the project and its authorized history remain.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The proposed business brand would stand behind that continuity across specialized products.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: AssistOS is one architectural contribution, rather than the whole commercial strategy.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The social chapters ask what makes repeated cooperation credible beyond an attention feed.
